metadata.case_name: RAZAQ-AKHTAR v. WANG HOI TRANSPORTATION LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: carrying carton boxes onto a pallet at the warehouse at Marine Cargo Terminal (cargo handler)

injuries.description: MRI shows mild prolapse of the L5/S1 disc.
source: MRI shows mild prolapse of the L5/S1 disc.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: he had sprained his back and sustained injury.
source: he had sprained his back and sustained injury.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: At the accident, he felt severe pain in his back and he could not stand up.
The back pain radiates down his left thigh the knees from time to time.
Marked muscle guarding and tenderness in the back
Reduced movement range of the trunk and limited straight leg raising
Increased pain after prolong sitting, standing, walking or lying in bed
intermittent pain in his lower back, more severe when he wakes up in the morning
He cannot pick up things from the floor
The back pain comes on when he sits or stands for more than half an hour
He has to rest after walking for 1 hour due to the back pain

treatments_received: treated at the A&E Department at the Princess Margaret Hospital
referred to the Orthopaedics and Traumatology specialist clinic

losses.description: Intermittent lower back pain with reduced range of trunk movement, limited straight leg raising, increased pain after prolonged sitting/standing/walking, cannot pick up things from the floor and must rest after walking for 1 hour.
Plaintiff is unable to return to his previous job at the cargo company and needs to change to jobs of lighter nature which do not require heavy lifting.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Plaintiff cannot pick up things from the floor and has limitations performing tasks requiring bending or lifting.
